title: 16S Illumina Primer Plate Aliquoting (5µM Forward & Reverse working plates)
author: Rodolfo A Salido Benitez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uz7ex9n
materials: ep.T.I.P.S. Motion Racks 1 - 50 µL w/ filter
ep.T.I.P.S. Motion Racks 20 - 300 µL w/ filter
96-Well plates of resuspended primers (100µM) from IDT
Barcoded forward primers (100µM) from IDT stock plates
Thaw and centrifuge 96-Well resuspended primer plates.

steps.title: Resuspend reverse primer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the lyophilized reverse primer to a final concentration of 100 µM.

steps.title: Prepare primer master mix
steps.instruction: In a sterile 30 mL reservoir, add 15,840 µL of PCR‑Clean Water and 880 µL of the 100 µM reverse primer, then mix to create enough solution for four 96‑well primer working plates.

substeps.instruction: Add 15,840 µL PCR‑Clean Water to the reservoir.
Add 880 µL reverse primer (100 µM) to the same reservoir.

steps.title: Set up epMotion worktable
steps.instruction: Arrange the epMotion 5075 liquid‑handling robot and accessories as shown:

substeps.instruction: Place four boxes of ep.T.I.P.S. Motion Racks 1‑50 µL with filter in slots A2, A3, A4, and A5.
Place one box of ep.T.I.P.S. Motion Racks 20‑300 µL with filter in slot B5.
Place four 96‑well plates containing the resuspended 100 µM primers (from IDT) in slots B1‑B4.
Place four empty 96‑well twin.tec plates in slots C1‑C4.
Place the 30 mL reservoir (containing reverse primer at 5.26 µM) in slot 1 of the Reservoir Rack, then position the Reservoir Rack in slot C5.

steps.title: Run automated primer aliquoting
steps.instruction: Import the epBlue protocol (Application_4_5uM_Primer_40ul_181003_105836.export6) into epBlue software version 40.6 or later, then execute it to dispense primers into the working plates.

substeps.instruction: Remove box lids and plate foils before starting.
Import the protocol file into epBlue and load it on the epMotion robot.
The robot will transfer 38 µL of reverse primer (5.26 µM) into each of the four 96‑well primer plates using the multidispense feature.
Next, the robot will transfer 2 µL of barcoded forward primers (100 µM) from the IDT stock plates into the same four 96‑well primer plates.

steps.title: Seal primer plates
steps.instruction: Remove the completed primer plates from the worktable and seal each with storage aluminum foil.
